accessibility.title: General Principles module introduction static overview
accessibility.long_description: A text-first overview of General Principles. Select an appropriate mechanics model, preserve dimensional consistency, convert SI units, report justified precision, follow a general analysis workflow, and recognize when virtual work is useful.

objective: Select an appropriate mechanics model, preserve dimensional consistency, convert SI units, report justified precision, follow a general analysis workflow, and recognize when virtual work is useful.
prerequisites: Begin with algebra, trigonometry, vector notation, SI base and derived units, and the distinction between a particle and a rigid body. These are framing prerequisites, not replacements for the signed procedures.

worked_example.entry_description: A loaded bracket is classified as a particle or rigid body, its governing quantities are written with consistent SI dimensions, and the analysis path is selected before calculation.

diagram_description: The planned mechanics model and dimensional-analysis workspace will support: select particle or rigid-body model; toggle modeling assumptions; convert a displayed quantity between allowed SI units; check dimensional consistency across an equation; step through the general analysis procedure; compare direct-equilibrium and virtual-work entry paths. Until v1.1.0 is published, this description and procedure map are the complete accessible fallback.
